column5: The offlineCart slice is persisted - it is in the redux-persist whitelist at src/lib/redux/store.ts:15 - so it is written to localStorage and survives a browser restart. clearOfflineCart is dispatched from exactly one place: syncOfflineCartToServer at src/helpers/updators.ts:110 and only on the success branch. handleLogout at src/helpers/auth.ts:656-684 clears the auth and cart and recentlyViewed slices and never clears offlineCart. So whenever the slice is non-empty at sign out it stays on the device - which is the normal outcome when a guest added items and never signed in - and also when a previous sync failed since the failure branch at :135-149 returns without clearing. Every login path then calls syncOfflineCartToServer before anything else - google at src/helpers/auth.ts:120 - apple at :225 - password at :608 and phone OTP at :771 - so the leftover items are posted into the NEW account server cart the moment the next person signs in on that device.

column8: Local access to a shared device - a family or office or public machine where one person signs out and another signs in
column11: A non-empty offline cart at sign out - a guest session that added items or a sync that previously failed.
column12: 1. As a guest add items to the cart on a shared device so the offline cart is populated. 2. Sign in as user A and then sign out - or leave the guest session and let a second person use the browser. 3. Sign in as user B on the same device. 4. Read user B server cart.
column13: The offline cart is scoped to the browsing session that created it and is discarded at sign out so it can never cross accounts.
column14: The leftover items are silently merged into whichever account signs in next.
column15: User B account receives products user A chose which discloses what A was shopping for and can be bought by accident at checkout. It also corrupts B cart totals without any action by B. The merge is silent - there is no prompt and no notice.
column16: Dispatch clearOfflineCart from handleLogout alongside the existing slice clears - and clear it on the sync failure branch too so a failed sync cannot leave items behind for the next account. If carrying a guest cart across a sign in is deliberate then prompt before merging rather than merging silently.
